rows.description: An adult returns extra change, admits an error nobody would find, or declines a favour that bends rules. The reward is mostly internal, and it builds a reputation for being trusted.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtype: Honouring a colleague who pays the price [Observer]
rows.description: A team sees someone lose a deal or promotion for refusing to lie. Recognising and supporting them keeps honesty from becoming a lonely choice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: Sometimes honesty conflicts with another duty, such as protecting a person from harm. A wise person considers who is affected, chooses the least deceptive path, and accepts responsibility for the choice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22
